completion_data.completion_summary: Trimmed agent-system/extensions/core/skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md from 20930 B to 19855 B by inverting the .status/.persisted_status contract's canonicality into orchestrate-state-machine.md and collapsing two MUST NOT section bodies into existing pointer targets, turning verify-deploy.sh gate 20 green with 145 B of margin and no contract content lost.

memory_candidates.content: When a SKILL.md or similar eager-loaded file breaches a per-file byte ceiling, check for prose already duplicated in a docs/architecture/*.md file before trimming content: inverting canonicality (expand the doc copy to be the full canonical text, replace the SKILL.md copy with a short pointer citing the doc's exact heading) removes bytes from the ceiling-bound file while strengthening, not weakening, the contract. Measure with `wc -c` before/after rather than estimating drafted byte counts -- a plan-level estimate can be off by tens of bytes once real prose is written.

verify-deploy.sh's gate 20 (orchestrator context budget lock) reads only the source-store copy of a file (agent-system/extensions/<ext>/<rel_path>), never the deployed .claude/ mirror -- so a source-store-only edit is sufficient to green the gate, and mirror sync is a separate deploy-workflow concern rather than a gate dependency. Confirm with `diff`/`wc -c` on both copies rather than assuming staleness.
